title: Titan Upper Body
description: Push and pull classics: diamond push-ups, decline push-ups and pike push-ups with a full back finish

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower chest to the floor

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands together under the chest, elbows close to the body

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hips high in an inverted V, lower the head between the hands

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, lift arms and legs simultaneously, hold 2s

exercises.name: Back extensions
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, lift your chest off the floor, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Floor face pulls
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, elbows at 90 degrees, pull backward

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread shoulder blades without bending elbows

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
